Deployable Energy took that slot; the Deployable selection is already shipped. Not written as a news item.

Oklo: latest found is an NRC-posted Q4 2026 licensing plan letter dated 2026-09-29, a plan update rather than a milestone. Not written up.
Valar Ward 250: ANS (2026-10-05) says DOE progressed Ward 250 through authorization for permitting, with no date or document given; the quote was partial and not verifiable verbatim. Not written up.
DOE HALEU third round to NASA and Radiant: DOE page found, but no date, quantity or fetched text in this pass. Not written up.
